content: {"like": [], "dislike": ["Overblown, overwrought, overdone, please god, make it be over.", "Tripe banal wasteful remake of a classic.", "Not as good as the '76 remake with Jessica Lange and Jeff Bridges.", "Not as good as 1963's KING KONG VS GODZILLA.", "Slightly better than KING KONG LIVES but still disappointing.", "Hollywood keeps churning out overblown over rendered special effects (CGI) laden films designed to get teenage boys to see them four or five times to drive the box office.", "General public continues to flock to these mediocre examples of pablum with little or no heart or story.", "Peter Jackson is allegedly a fan of the original 1933 classic but missed the very most basic point of the original.", "Kong is portrayed as a potbellied silverback gorilla instead of a creature between man and ape.", "The movie mercifully flopped at the box office, saving us from the threat of a Jackson helmed sequel.", "Don't waste your time on this steaming pile of monkey doo."]}
